description: Column smoke: the smoke mass in the model column per unit area (ug kg-1 x dry-air mass per layer area, scaled to mg m-2)

terms.from: DESIGN section 8 (ArWen addition, not a WRF-Chem sum)

provenance: ArWen-only 2-D output (DESIGN section 8), the counterpart of HRRR-Smoke's COLMD over the entire atmosphere; WRF-Chem has no such field.
